Buf Idx Index of the message buffer, where the Upper Layer expects egress time stamping Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) time Qual Ptr quality of HW time stamp, e.g. based on current drift time Stamp Ptr current time stamp Return value Std _ Return - Type E_ OK: success E_ NOT_ OK: failed to read time stamp. Description Reads back the egress time stamp on a dedicated message object. It must be called within the Tx Confirmation() function. Available via Eth If.h
